|quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Automation''' is a [[hybrid gem]]. While the Automation skill is active, skills supported by '''Automation Support''' [[trigger]] immediately and automatically once off [[cooldown]]. It supports [[instant]] [[spell]]s without a [[reservation]]. It cannot support skills used by [[totem]]s, [[trap]]s, or [[mine]]s. ==Skill functions and interactions== {{main|Instant}} Automation can support multiple instant spells at once. Each skill will be used off cooldown independently. Note that most [[guard skill]]s and instant movement skills share cooldowns, preventing subsequent linked skills of that category from triggering. For example, it can be used to automate {{il|Steelskin}}, {{il|Withering Step}}, and {{il|Detonate Mines}} all at once. It is not possible to automate [[aura]]s supported by [[Divine Blessing Support]], as Divine Blessing adds a cast time to the aura. Automation does not trigger spells in [[hideout]]s. ===List of skills supportable by Automation=== {{Drop enabled gem table |tables=skill_gems |join=items._pageID=skill_gems._pageID |where = items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND skill.cast_time = 0 AND (skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS NOT "Aura" OR items.name IN ("War Banner", "Defiance Banner", "Dread Banner")) AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Herald%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Tempest Shield%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Arctic Armour%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Spellslinger%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Blood and Sand%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Automation%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Autoexertion%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Call to Arms%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Petrified Blood%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Vaal%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Bladefall of Trarthus%" }} ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Cooldown
